DYNO & MOTOR Modes
==================

DYNO Mode
---------

Describe the torque/load profile options, e.g.:

- Constant load
- Trapezoidal load
- Fan load (k · n²)
- Sine load
- Angle-dependent loads
- Table-driven profiles (unbalanced, broken bearing, triangle, etc.)

MOTOR Mode
----------

Describe:

- Constant torque
- Constant speed
- Trapezoidal speed profiles
- How to switch between DYNO and MOTOR mode
